exact_statement: For real child capacities S_c=V_c+W_c with V_c,W_c>=0 and 0<=T<=mean S_c, the minimum mean max(d_c-V_c,0) over 0<=d_c<=S_c, mean d_c=T is max(0,T-mean V_c). If mean S_c=S+e and T=D+e, this equals max(0,mean W_c-(S-D)). When D=S every feasible d_c equals S_c, consuming all W_c. For the 60 prescribed J(g^6) inherited-prefix queries at K=4, exact symbolic component profiles certify V_c>=0, S_c>0, T>0; the 30 saturated queries all require positive donor payment, and 6 of the other 30 require donor payment. The optimizer preserves all inherited labels.
